description_en: Configures an SSL certificate for a specific domain name
description_zh: 调用SetCdnDomainCSRCertificate设置指定域名下的HTTPS证书
kebab_example: aliyun cdn set-cdn-domain-csr-certificate --server-certificate example-string --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetCdnDomainCSRCertificate

parameters.help_en: The content of the certificate. The certificate must match the certificate signing request (CSR) created by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144478.html operation. Make sure that the content of the certificate is encoded in Base64 and then encoded by encodeURIComponent
parameters.help_zh: 证书内容。该证书必须是通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144478.html接口创建的CSR对应的签名证书，内部必须是PEM格式的证书，Base64编码后再通过encodeURIComponent
parameters.name: server_certificate

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for which you want to configure an SSL certificate. The domain name must have HTTPS secure acceleration enabled
parameters.help_zh: 要设置的加速域名，需属于HTTPS加速类型
parameters.name: domain_name
